thread:
Emily: quick bug: noticed two issues in the Console observability docs when testing staging dashboards — (1) sidebar link 'Tracing hooks quickstart' 404s, (2) the 'cost by route' example errors when traces are unsampled (span_id missing) and the dashboard vizzes return 500s. anyone seen this?
Sahil: saw the 500s before. dashboard query groups by `span_id` and `route` so empty span buckets blow up. easy fix is `coalesce(span_id, "unsampled")` and also be defensive about label name changes (`route` -> `route_name`).
Emily: can you paste the suggested promql? will update the migration guide.
Sahil: short PromQL we use in staging: `sum(cost_total) by (route, coalesce(span_id, "unsampled"))`
Sahil: bonus: if your SDK now emits `route_name` use `by (coalesce(route, route_name, "unknown"), coalesce(span_id, "unsampled"))` so old dashboards keep working.
Ben: also watch out for quantized endpoints — token duration can be recorded as ms vs seconds. if dashboards assume seconds you get NaN on p95. normalize: `coalesce(rate(token_duration_seconds[5m]), rate(token_duration_ms[5m]) / 1000)` in the aggregation.
Emily: good call. i'll add a short migration section: "Dashboards: update groupings to use coalesce for span_id and route/route_name; normalize token duration units for quantized models."
Sahil: SDK snippets? teams asked for a Ruby example for tagging requests so dashboards can split cost/latency by route.
Emily: yes, include node/python/ruby -- keep tiny.
Sahil: Ruby snippet:
```ruby
# attach route metadata for cost/latency dashboards
resp = client.generate("") do |opts|
  opts.metadata = { "route_name" => "signup_flow" }
end
```
Sahil: Node quick one-liner: `await client.generate('', {metadata:{route_name:'signup_flow'}})`
Ben: Python: `resp = client.generate("", metadata={"route_name":"signup_flow"})`
Emily: nice. i'll add those to the PR and include a one-line regression curl test to avoid 500 regressions.
Ben: curl test example: `curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.internal/query -d '{"query":"sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, \"unknown\"), coalesce(span_id, \"unsampled\"))"}' | jq`
Emily: also the sidebar trace link — it's pointing at `/tracing-hook.md` which was removed. replacement is `/observability/tracing-hooks/quickstart`. can someone add redirects?
eng-frontend: filing ENG-480 for sidebar redirect + permalinks, ETA tomorrow morning.

Sahil: left one tiny wording nit about "normalize" -> "reconcile units". otherwise LGTM.
